title: Blucon unknown state
symptom: Blucon connects and gets bonded when enabling 'Close GATT on BLE disconnect', but xDrip+ always says 'Can't use this sensor as it is in an unknown state'. The Link Blucon app works. Rebooting, deleting the app, unpairing, and resetting did not help.
evidence_quote: my Blucon does connect it also gets bonded when I enable the option: 'Close GATT on BLE disconnect' but it always says: 'Can't use this sensor as it is in an unknown state'.
